A ṣe iwadi ni adugbo lati mọ irú aja to bu ọmọ naa jẹ, olowo aja naa si sọ wipe awọn kò gba abẹrẹ fun aja naa rí, wipe lẹyin ki o jade, ko ṣere, ko si pada wọle. Wọn ni awọn o gba itọju kankan fun aja naa rí. Idi eyi ni ẹru ṣe bami lati gbe ọmọ naa wa si ile-iwosan, ko ma jẹ wipe aja to bu ọmọ naa jẹ, o jẹ aja digbolugi. Ki lo ṣeṣe ko ṣẹlẹ si ọmọ ti aja bu jẹ yi? Ki lo ṣeṣe ko ṣẹlẹ si oju egbo ti o n pọn, ti o si n wú? N jẹ o ṣeṣe ki ẹran ipa ti ẹ ti wọnu egbo yi? N jẹ o ṣeṣe ki ọmọ naa... ki nkan ko ṣe ọmọ naa latari ọmọ ti aja bu jẹ? Ẹ jọọ...
Awọn wo ni mo le ṣe lati ma jẹ ki ẹran ipa wọnu egbo yi? Awọn abẹrẹ wo, awọn ogun wo ni a le fi tọju ọmọde yi lati jẹ ko ni itọju to peye? Awọn wo ni a tun le ṣe tabi ayẹwo wo la le ṣe lati tọju oju egbo ti aja ti bu ọmọde yi jẹ?
model_answer: Egbò tó pọ́n tí ó sì wú yẹn fi hàn pé kòkòrò àrùn bakitéríà ti wọ ojú ọgbẹ́ náà, èyí tó léwu púpọ̀ nítorí ajá tí kò gba abẹ́rẹ́ rí lè fa àrùn wèrè ajá (rabies) àti rọpárọsẹ̀ (tetanus) tí ó lè ṣèkúpani fún ọmọ yín. Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìtọ́jú àkọ́kọ́ nínú ìmọ̀ ìṣègùn, a gbọ́dọ̀ fi omi tó ń ṣàn àti ọṣẹ fọ ojú egbò náà dáadáa fún bíi iṣẹ́jú mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún láti fọ itọ́ ajá àti kòkòrò àrùn kúrò. Lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ ni a gbọ́dọ̀ fún ọmọ yín ní abẹ́rẹ́ ajẹsára láti dènà wèrè ajá (Anti-rabies vaccine) pẹ̀lú abẹ́rẹ́ rọpárọsẹ̀ (Tetanus toxoid) láti dáàbò bo ẹ̀mí rẹ̀ kí àrùn náà má baà ràn án. A máa kọ àwọn egbòogi apakòkòrò (antibiotics) àti oògùn ìrọ̀ra (painkillers) fún un láti wo egbò tó wú yẹn san kíákíá kí kòkòrò má baà ràn dé inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ rẹ̀. Ní parí, lẹ́yìn tí a bá bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú yìí, ẹ gbọ́dọ̀ gba àwọn tó ni ajá yẹn níyànjú láti de ajá náà kí wọ́n sì ṣọ́ ọ fún ọjọ́ mẹ́wàá sí mẹ́rìnlá láti mọ̀ bóyá yóò ṣáńkú, èyí yóò ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti mọ ìtọ́jú tókàn fún ọmọ yín.

question: Alágbà tó ṣàkíyèsí wípé ọmọ náà ń wúkọ́ gidigidi débi pé ó ń ta gì pé ọmọ náà gbìyànjú tiraka láti mí dáradára ni ó lè fa kí ọmọ kí ó máa wúkó àtarìbi wí pé kò lè mí dáadáa tó ń tiraka láti mi irú ni a lè ṣe fún ọmọ náà ìtọ́jú wo ni a lè fún Bákan náà irú ìmọ̀ràn wo ni a lè gba ìyá ọ lágbà ìtọ́jú ọmọdé náà?
reference: Alágbàtọ́ ọmọ kan ṣàkíyèsí pé ọmọ náà wúkọ́ gidigidi, dé bi pé òun tàgìrì àti wí pé ọmọ náà gbìyànjú tiraka láti mí dáradára ni. Kí ó le fa kí ọmọ kí ó máa n wúkọ́ àwú tagìrì, débi wípé kò le mí dáadáa, tó tiraka láti mí? Irú àyẹ̀wò wo la lè ṣe fún ọmọ náà? Irú ìtọ́jú wo la lè fún? Bákan náà irú àmọ̀rà wo la lè gba Alágbàtọ́ ọmọ náà?
model_answer: Ikọ́ líle tí ń mu kí ọmọdé tiraka láti mí dáadáa sábà máa ń wáyé látàrí àìsàn kọ̀lọ̀kọ̀lọ̀ (pneumonia), ikọ́ fée (asthma), tàbí ikọ́ égbé (whooping cough), èyí tí ó jẹ́ pàjáwìrì tí ó lè gbẹ̀mí ọmọ. Ìtọ́jú tí ọmọ náà nílò ní kíákíá ní ilé-ìwòsàn ni ẹ̀rọ atẹ́gùn (oxygen) àti oògùn apakòkòrò (antibiotics) tàbí èyí tó ń ṣí ọ̀nà ọ̀fun (bronchodilators) láti jẹ́ kí èémí rẹ̀ gún wá. Ìmọ̀ràn pàtàkì jùlọ fún ìyá ọmọ náà ni kí ó gbé ọmọ sá lọ sí ilé-ìwòsàn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀, kí ó má ṣe fi àkókò ṣòfò tàbí fún un ní agbo àti oògùn ìbílẹ̀ kankan. Nígbà tí wọ́n bá wà ní ọ̀nà ilé-ìwòsàn, kí ìyá gbé ọmọ náà dá dúró (upright position) gbé ọ̀yà rẹ̀ sókè láti jẹ́ kí ó rí atẹ́gùn mí dáadáa. Bákan náà, ìmọ̀ràn pàtàkì fún ìyá ni pé ó gbọ́dọ̀ rí i dájú pé ọmọ rẹ̀ gba gbogbo abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára (immunization) rẹ̀ lẹ́kùn-únrẹ́rẹ́ láti dènà àwọn àrùn burúkú wọ̀nyí lọ́jọ́ iwájú.

question: Arabinrin ọmọ ogbon odun lo bimọ bi iṣẹju merinlelogbon seyin a sọ pe bi ṣe rọrun nigba ti arabinrin yii bi ọmọ rẹ omo naa n sun ju o nira fun gan lati ke ko si ṣe daada ọmọ naa ko sunkun pupọ lẹsẹkẹsẹ nigbati a bi tan o si dabi ẹni pe o nira fun lati ji Àwọ̀ ara rẹ̀ dá bí ẹni pé ó fẹ́ sán kò gbé apá rẹ̀ àti ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ dáadáa bó ṣe yẹ kó gbún lè jẹun torí wípé ó ń sùn jù kò sì lè fa ọmú dáadáa ìyá ọmọ náà ṣe àníyàn wípé àwọn ọmọ òun tó bí tẹ́lẹ̀ kété tí òun bá bí wọn tán, wọ́n máa ń sunkún lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ yìí? Àwọn àyẹ̀wò wo ni a lè ṣe lórí ọmọ náà àti wípé ìgbésẹ̀ ìpajárì wo ni a gbọ́dọ̀ gbé lórí ọmọ náà kò ké dáadáa bó ṣe yẹ kó sunkún fá ọmú dáadáa náà kí la lè ṣe lórí ọmọ náà kékeré ni ọmọ tó ṣẹ̀bi ni ọmọ náà kí la lè ṣe fún ọmọ náà?
reference:
Arábìnrin kan, ẹni ọdún ọgbọ̀n, ló bímọ ní ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn. A sọ pé ìbímọ náà lọ dáadáa. Ṣùgbọ́n láti ìgbà tí a bí ọmọ náà, ọmọ náà ń ṣòro gan-an. Kò ń sunkún dáadáa, kò sì ń dáhùn bí ọmọ tuntun ṣe yẹ.
Lẹ́yìn ìbí, ọmọ náà kò súnkún dáadáa, ó sì dà bí ẹni pé ó ní ìṣòro láti jí. Ara rẹ̀ dá bí ẹni pé kò rọrùn, ọwọ́ àti ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ kò ń rìn dáadáa bí ó ṣe yẹ. Kò tún lè jẹun dáadáa, ó sì ń ṣòro fún un láti fà ọmú.
Ìyá ọmọ náà ṣe àníyàn torí pé àwọn ọmọ rẹ̀ tó ti bí tẹ́lẹ̀ máa ń sunkún lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ìbí. Kí ni ó lè fà ìṣòro yìí? Àwọn àyẹ̀wò wo ni a lè ṣe lórí ọmọ náà, àti kí ni ìgbésẹ̀ pajawiri tí a lè gbé? Kí ni a lè ṣe fún ọmọ kékeré yìí?
model_answer:
Àpẹẹrẹ yìí fi hàn wípé ọmọ tuntun náà kò rí afẹ́fẹ́ (oxygen) tó péye mí sínú nígbà tí wọ́n ń bí i, èyí tí àwa dókítà ń pè ní 'Neonatal Asphyxia'. 

Ìgbésẹ̀ ìpàjáwìrì tí a gbọ́dọ̀ gbé ni pé kí á nu ọ̀nà ọ̀fun rẹ̀ mọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀, kí á fún un ní afẹ́fẹ́ oxygen láti ràn án lọ́wọ́, kí á sì mu kí ara rẹ̀ móoru dáadáa kí ó má baà tutù. 

Àwọn àyẹ̀wò pàtàkì tí a gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ ni wíwọn ìwọ̀n ṣúgà inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ rẹ̀ (nítorí pé ó le ti lọ sílẹ̀ jù), yíyẹ̀wò ìwọ̀n afẹ́fẹ́ oxygen, àti àyẹ̀wò ẹ̀jẹ̀ títí kan ti àkóràn àrùn (infection screen/FBC). 

Níwọ̀n bí kò ti lè fa ọmú, a gbọ́dọ̀ gbé e lọ sí yàrá àkànṣe fún àwọn ọmọ tuntun (SCBU) láti fún un ní omi àti ìtọ́jú gba ojú iṣan (IV fluids) títí yóò fi lágbára láti fúnra rẹ̀ mu ọmú. 

Ìgbésẹ̀ kánjú-kánjú yìí ṣe pàtàkì púpọ̀ nínú ìmọ̀ ìṣègùn wa níbí láti gba ẹ̀mí ọmọ náà là, kí á sì dènà ìpalára burúkú fún ọpọlọ rẹ̀.

question: Iya kan ninu aramọ wa ti o maa n gbe omo wa fun abun ni o salaye pe o n sakiyesi pe omo tuntun ohun to sese pe ibi ẹnu ẹnu ete re pe o n sakiyesi pe o blu ori bi alawọ alaro pe itere ete omo ohun tuntun sese bi pe o ri bii ete alawala. O ni o si tun sakiyesi pe omo tiraka o n ja pera lati mi to n jape tirada lati mi ti n ba ti n fun lọmu oni to nkiye si ni pe ounkan ti o ṣẹlẹ ọmọ tuntun to sese bi kin la le sọ pe o fate omo yente omo tuntun to fi wa ri biyin. alaro to fi ri bi alaro abi ki lo le sele gan to mo eyi fira toraka lati mi to yi o ṣa le ko oogun fun abika se ayewo fun omo naa
reference:
Ìyá kan nínú àwọn olómo wá, ẹni tí ó máa ń gbé ọmọ wá fún abẹ́rẹ́, ni ó ṣàlàyé pé òun ṣe àkíyèsí pé ọmọ tuntun tí òun ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bí ní ìbàjẹ́ kan ní ẹnu, ète rẹ̀ sì dà bí aláwọ̀ aláró.
Òní, ó tún ṣàkíyèsí pé nígbà tí òun bá ń fún ọmọ náà lómu, ọmọ náà máa ń tiraka, ó máa ń jápítìrà, ó sì ń ṣòro fún un láti mi dáadáa. Ó sọ pé ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yìí ló jẹ́ kó bẹ̀rù, torí kò mọ ohun tí ń ṣẹlẹ̀ sí ọmọ náà.
Kí ló lè fà kí ète ọmọ tuntun dà bí aláwọ̀ aláró? Kí ni ó tún lè fà kí ọmọ máa jápítìrà, kí ó sì máa tiraka láti mi nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń fún un lómu? Ṣé a lè fún un ní oogun tàbí ṣé ó yẹ kí a ṣe àyẹ̀wò fún ọmọ náà?
model_answer: Ete ọmọ ti o n dudu tabi fihan bi alaró (cyanosis) ati inira lati mi nigba ti o ba n mu ọmú jẹ àmì pé atẹgun (oxygen) ko kaakiri ara rẹ̀ daadaa, eyi ti o maa n waye nipasẹ àrùn ọkàn lati ibí (bii iho ninu ọkàn) tabi àkóràn ẹ̀dọ̀fóró to le gan-an (severe pneumonia). Mímu ọmú gba agbara pupọ fun ọmọ tuntun, eyi lo n fa wahala fun ọkàn ati ẹ̀dọ̀fóró rẹ̀ ti o fi n tiraka lati mí nigba ti o ba n jẹun. Ẹ má ṣe ra oògùn kankan fun ọmọ yii nile tabi ninu kẹmisi nitori pe ipo pajawiri ti o le gba ẹmi rẹ̀ ni eyi jẹ. Ẹ mu ọmọ naa lọ si ile-iwosan nla ni kánjúkánjú ki awọn dọkita le fun u ni atẹgun pajawiri (oxygen) ati lati ṣe ayẹwo tó jinlẹ̀ bii yiya aworan àyà (Chest X-ray) tabi ayẹwo ọkàn (Echocardiogram). Ṣiṣe ayẹwo yii ni ile-iwosan nikan ni yoo jẹ ki a mọ ohun gangan to n fa a, ki a si le bẹrẹ itọju to tọ lati gba ẹmi ọmọ naa là.

question: Mo ṣe àkíyèsí pé àbúrò mi obìnrin tí ó máa ń rerin dáadáa tẹ́lẹ̀ tí ó sì máa ń bá àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ ṣeré ti yípadà lójijì ní báyìí ó máa ń wà nìkan nínú yàrá rẹ̀ lójoojúmọ́ yara rẹ kúrò ní ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ kò sì tún nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí àwọn ohun tó máa ń fẹ́ràn tẹ́lẹ̀. Mo ṣe àkíyèsí pé nínú ilé gan kò fẹ́ máa bá wa jẹun ó sì dàbí ẹni pé. inú rẹ̀ kò dùn tàbí ẹni tí ó máa ń rẹ̀ nígbà gbogbo tí ó fi ń yẹra fún àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ lójijì ó lè jẹ́ ìṣòro bí ìbànújẹ́ ìfẹ̀sùn ọkàn tàbí àníyàn báwo ni a ṣe lè ràn lọ́wọ́ kí inú rẹ̀ lè dùn sí àwọn àmì ìkìlọ̀ wo la gbọ́dọ̀ máa ṣọ́ra fún? Ṣé ó yẹ kó rí olùgbani-nímọ̀ràn tàbí amòye ìlera ọpọlọ?
reference:
Mo ṣe àkíyèsí pé àbúrò mi obìnrin, tí ó máa ń rẹ́rìn-ín dáadáa tẹ́lẹ̀, tí ó sì máa ń bá àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ ṣeré, ti yí padà lójijì.
Ní báyìí, ó máa ń wà nìkan nínú yàrá rẹ̀ lójoojúmọ́. Ó ya ara rẹ̀ kúrò ní ìbánisọ̀rọ̀, kò sì tún nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí àwọn ohun tó máa ń fẹ́ràn tẹ́lẹ̀.
Mo ṣe àkíyèsí pé nínú ilé gan-an, kò fẹ́ máa bá wa jẹun. Ó sì dà bí ẹni pé inú rẹ̀ kò dùn tàbí ẹni tí ó máa ń rẹ̀ ní gbogbo ìgbà.
Kí ló fa tí ó fi ń yẹra fún àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ lójijì?
Ṣé ó lè jẹ́ ìṣòro bí ìbànújẹ́, ìfẹ̀sùn ọkàn, tàbí àníyàn?
Báwo ni a ṣe lè ràn án lọ́wọ́ kí inú rẹ̀ lè dùn sí i?
Àwọn àmì ìkìlọ̀ wo la gbọ́dọ̀ máa ṣọ́ra fún?
Ṣé ó yẹ kí ó rí olùgbani-nímọ̀ràn tàbí amòye ìlera ọpọlọ?
model_answer: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí dókítà, àwọn àmì tí o ṣàlàyé yìí gẹ́gẹ́ bíi dídáwà, àìnífẹ̀ẹ́ sí ohun tó fẹ́ràn tẹ́lẹ̀, ìbànújẹ́, àti àárẹ̀ jẹ́ àmì tó hàn gbangba fún àrùn ìdààmú-ọkàn (depression). Ẹ nílò láti súnmọ́ ọn pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ àti sùúrù láì dá a lẹ́bi, kí ẹ jẹ́ kó mọ̀ pé ẹ kò ní pa á tì nínú àsìkò líle yìí. Àwọn àmì ìkìlọ̀ tó léwu tí ẹ gbọ́dọ̀ tètè kíyèsí ni sísọ̀rọ̀ nípa ikú, wíwá ọ̀nà láti pa ara rẹ̀ lára, tàbí kíkọ̀ pátápátá láti jẹun àti láti tọ́jú ara rẹ̀. Bẹ́ẹ̀ni, ó pọn dandan kí ẹ tètè tì í lẹ́yìn láti lọ rí amòye nípa ìlera ọpọlọ (psychiatrist tàbí therapist) ní ilé-ìwòsàn fún àyẹ̀wò tó péye lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Ìgbaninímọ̀ràn àti ìtọ́jú oògùn láti ọwọ́ àwọn amòye yìí, pẹ̀lú àtìlẹ́yìn ìdílé, yóò ṣètọ́jú kẹ́míkà inú ọpọlọ rẹ̀ tó ti yípadà, yóò sì ràn án lọ́wọ́ láti padà bọ̀ sípò.

question: arábìnrin kan ló mú arábìnrin tí ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bímọ láìpẹ́ wá sí ilé ìwòsàn wa sọ wí pé àti ìgbà tí ọmọ àwọn ti bímọ níse ni ó ń da ẹ̀jẹ̀ ní ojú ara kíkankíkan sì jẹ́ wípé kò sí okan lára ọmọ àwọn mọ́ Ẹni tí o bímọ yìí jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún mẹ́rìnlé ogún ó sì wí pé ẹ̀jẹ̀ náà pọ̀ tó ń dà lójú ara ọmọ kò ríbi jẹun kò rí ṣe ohunkóhun ìbéèrè mi ni pé. Kí ló fà tí arábìnrin yìí tí o máa da ẹ̀jẹ̀ ní ojú ara lẹ́yìn tí ó ti bímọ fún ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn ti ẹni tí ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bímọ ní ọjọ́ kí a lè fún ìyá náà láti lè jẹ́ kí ẹ̀jẹ̀ náà dá àti láti lè jẹ́ kí ara wọn múkùn sí Ìmọ̀ràn Bólá lè gba ìyá àti arábìnrin ìbí
reference:
Ìyá arábìnrin kan tí ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bí ọmọ wá sí ilé ìwòsàn. Ó sọ pé láti ìgbà tí ọmọ òun ti bí ni ó ti ń da ẹ̀jẹ̀ gidigidi. Ó sì jẹ́ pé kò sí okun lára rẹ̀ mọ́. Ẹni tí ó bí ọmọ yìí jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún mẹ́rìnlélógún. Ó tún sọ pé ẹ̀jẹ̀ náà pọ̀ tó, ó sì ń dà á lójú. Ìyá ọmọ náà kò rí bí jẹun, kò sì rí bí ṣe ohunkóhun.
Ìbéèrè mi ni pé, kí ló lè fa tí arábìnrin kan fi máa ń da ẹ̀jẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí ó ti bí ọmọ fún ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn? Ìtọ́jú wo la yẹ fún ìyá náà láti lè jẹ́ kí ẹ̀jẹ̀ náà dá dúró àti láti jẹ́ kí ara rẹ̀ mú kúrò? Ìmọ̀ràn wo la lè gbà fún ìyá àti arábìnrin yìí?
model_answer:
Ẹ̀jẹ̀ kíkankíkan tí ó ń dà lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ tí ó bímọ yìí ni a ń pè ní "Secondary Postpartum Hemorrhage", èyí tí ó sábà máa ń wáyé tí ibi-ọmọ (placenta) tàbí ẹ̀jẹ̀ dídì bá ṣẹ́kù sí inú ilé-ọmọ, tàbí kí kòkòrò àrùn (infection) wọ ibẹ̀. 

Láti dá ẹ̀jẹ̀ náà dúró àti láti sọ ọ́ jí, a gbọ́dọ̀ kán omi (IV fluids) tàbí fa ẹ̀jẹ̀ sí i lára kánkán nítorí àárẹ̀ rẹ̀, kí a sì fún un ní oògùn bíi 'Oxytocin' tàbí 'Misoprostol' láti jẹ́ kí ilé-ọmọ rẹ̀ súnkì (contract). 

Bákan náà, dọ́kítà yóò fọ inú ilé-ọmọ rẹ̀ láti mú ìdọ̀tí tàbí ibi-ọmọ tó ṣẹ́kù jáde, a ó sì fún un ní oògùn agbóguntàrùn (antibiotics) láti pa kòkòrò àrùn.

Nígbà tí ẹ̀jẹ̀ yìí bá dúró tí ara rẹ̀ sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í balẹ̀, ó gbọ́dọ̀ máa jẹ oúnjẹ aṣaralóore tó ń fúnni lẹ́jẹ̀ (bíi ẹ̀fọ́ àti ẹran), mu oògùn ẹ̀jẹ̀, kí ó sì sinmi dáadáa láti lè padà bọ̀ sípò.

reference: Arabinrin kan omu omọ rẹ, ọmọ ọdún mẹ́ta, wá sí ilé ìwé sánà wá ní owuro yi pelu àlàyé wípé tí wọn bá ń bá ọmọ náà sọ̀rọ̀, kò tiẹ̀ ní ṣe bìgà níwípé kò ní wọn bá wí, kò ní wòjú ẹni tó ń bá sọ̀rọ̀, àti wípé tí wọn bá ń pe orúkọ rẹ̀, kò tiẹ̀ ní ṣe bìgà wípé ó gbọ́ rárá. model_answer: Your safety and that of your unborn baby are the topmost priorities, so you must immediately stop taking the traditional herbal remedy (locally known as *agbo*) as it can be highly toxic to your pregnancy. The fear and racing heart you experience are direct psychological and physical reactions to the trauma of domestic violence, which is also dangerously raising your blood pressure. To restore your peace of mind, we will immediately involve our hospital's social welfare team and local support organizations to help you find a safe shelter away from the abuse, as emotional calmness is impossible while you remain in danger. Our medical team will also closely monitor your blood pressure, assess your baby's health, and provide professional counseling alongside safe relaxation techniques to manage your anxiety. Please do not return to a hostile environment alone; let us support you in securing your safety and health first.

question: My name is Mrs Akinleye. For about the past two months, I have noticed that my husband's breathing has not been normal at all. He also sneezes repeatedly, especially whenever he is in a dusty environment or in a place where something is being fried. He sneezes repeatedly and finds it difficult to breathe properly. His breathing becomes labored and he tends to sneeze whenever he's in places with smoke. Smoke or dust, is there any test that can be carried out to determine exactly what is causing these symptoms? Could staying in dusty places be the cause or is his body's system changing in a way that is making this happen? What type of medication can he use so that his breathing will become normal and comfortable at all times wherever he may be?
reference:
My name is Mrs. Akinleye. For about the past two months, I have noticed that my husband's breathing has not been normal at all. He also sneezes repeatedly, especially whenever he is in a dusty environment or in a place where something is being fried. He sneezes repeatedly and finds it difficult to breathe properly.

His breathing becomes laboured, and he tends to sneeze whenever he is in places with smoke or dust.

Is there any test that can be carried out to determine exactly what is causing these symptoms? Could staying in dusty places be the cause, or is his body's system changing in a way that is making this happen? What type of medication can he use so that his breathing will become normal and comfortable at all times, wherever he may be?
model_answer: Hello Mrs. Akinleye, your husband's symptoms of sneezing and labored breathing triggered by dust and smoke strongly suggest a combination of Allergic Rhinitis and Asthma, where his immune system has become hypersensitive to these environmental irritants. To determine the exact cause, a doctor can perform a lung function test called Spirometry, a chest X-ray, and allergy tests to assess his airway response. For long-term comfort, he will likely need prescription medications, including daily oral antihistamines for the sneezing, and a preventer steroid inhaler alongside a reliever inhaler (like Salbutamol) to keep his airways open. In the meantime, he must strictly avoid dusty or smoky environments and wear a protective face mask when these triggers are unavoidable. Please visit a clinic or community hospital promptly for a proper medical evaluation and prescription, as self-medication for breathing difficulties can be dangerous.

question: I took my pregnant friend who is 18 years old to the hospital because she had gone into labor and her time had come. When we arrived at the hospital and they had carried out all the necessary assessments, her blood pressure was high. After they had completed all that needed to be done, she continued in labor. She remained in labor for about 12 hours. Her husband was nearby and the doctors advised that she should give consent for a Kesarian section. because she had been in labor for a long time. My friend refused. She said, No, not at all. I want to give birth naturally like the Hebrew woman. She eventually delivered the baby. After 12 hours of labor, she gave birth to a healthy looking baby girl and we thanked God. However, what was surprising was that the baby was not breathing properly. They stimulated the baby repeatedly, patting and rubbing her. She cried, but her breathing was still not normal. They quickly gave her oxygen. Doctor, please, will this baby survive? And if she survives, will she now become a disabled child?
reference:
I took my pregnant friend, who is eighteen years old, to the hospital because she had gone into labour and her time had come. When we arrived at the hospital and they had carried out all the necessary assessments, her blood pressure was high.
After they had completed all that needed to be done, she continued in labour. She remained in labour for about twelve hours. Her husband was nearby, and the doctors advised that she should give consent for a Caesarean section because she had been in labour for a long time.
My friend refused. She said, “No, not at all. I want to give birth naturally like the Hebrew women.”
She eventually delivered the baby. After twelve hours of labour, she gave birth to a healthy-looking baby girl, and we thanked God. However, what was surprising was that the baby was not breathing properly. They stimulated the baby repeatedly, patting and rubbing her. She cried, but her breathing was still not normal. They quickly gave her oxygen.
Doctor, please, will this baby survive? And if she survives, will she no become a disabled child?
model_answer: Yes, the baby has a strong chance of survival now that she is receiving oxygen and medical care, but her ultimate recovery depends on how quickly her brain and lungs recover from the stress of delivery. The combination of her mother's high blood pressure and the 12 hours of prolonged labor likely reduced oxygen flow to the baby, causing a condition known as birth asphyxia. While this lack of oxygen puts the baby at risk for future developmental delays or cerebral palsy, her crying after stimulation is a positive sign that brain function is preserved. To prevent long-term disability, the baby must be closely monitored in a Special Care Baby Unit (SCBU) for any complications like seizures or poor feeding. I strongly advise cooperating with the medical team for ongoing assessments and pediatric follow-up, as early intervention can significantly improve her chances of living a normal, healthy life.

question: Doctor, a mother living in our house began to notice that her baby was not breastfeeding well. Whenever she tried to breastfeed the baby, the baby would suck for a little while and then stop as if exhausted. The mother also noticed that the baby did not have enough strength to breastfeed and would sweat heavily on the head and face. Not only that, the baby's breathing changed. It seemed as though the baby was breathing upward and downward, like someone struggling to breathe. As the days went by, the mother became increasingly worried. She wondered whether it was because the baby was not feeding enough or whether there was a problem related to the baby's breathing and sweating. Therefore, she decided to go to the hospital to see a doctor for an examination of the baby. My question is, what could cause a baby to have difficulty breastfeeding properly? Is the way the baby is breathing a sign of any health problem? What danger signs should the baby's parents Watch out for what could cause a young child to sweat while breastfeeding.

The mother also noticed that the baby did not have enough strength to breastfeed and would sweat heavily on the head and face. Not only that, the baby's breathing changed; it seemed as though the baby was breathing upward and downward, like someone struggling to breathe.
As the days went by, the mother became increasingly worried. She wondered whether it was because the baby was not feeding enough, or whether there was a problem related to the baby's breathing and sweating. Therefore, she decided to go to the hospital to see a doctor for an examination of the baby.

model_answer: The combination of poor feeding, sweating during feeds, and labored breathing ("upward and downward") strongly suggests heart failure, commonly caused by a congenital heart defect (often called a "hole in the heart" locally) or a severe chest infection like pneumonia. Sweating occurs because feeding becomes an exhausting physical exertion for a struggling heart, triggering a stress response in the baby's body. The abnormal breathing is indeed a serious sign of respiratory distress, showing the baby is working dangerously hard to get enough oxygen. Parents must urgently watch for critical danger signs like a bluish color around the lips or tongue (cyanosis), grunting, deep chest pulling, or extreme weakness. Please take this baby to a hospital immediately for an urgent medical evaluation, as these symptoms require prompt, life-saving intervention.

question: A caregiver who is taking care of a small child noticed that the child is caring for is struggling to breathe and the child's breathing is not normal. She also noticed that the child coughs repeatedly and the cough is very severe. The child is not a baby that was abandoned at birth nor a child that is usually bathed with cold water. What then can cause a small child to be breathing with difficulty and coughing repeatedly? And why would breathing not be easy for the child as it should be? What can be done about this situation?
reference:
A caregiver who is taking care of a small child noticed that the child she is caring for is struggling to breathe, and the child's breathing is not normal.
She also noticed that the child coughs repeatedly, and the cough is very severe.
The child is not a baby that was abandoned at birth, nor a child that is usually bathed with cold water.
What then can cause a small child to be breathing with difficulty and coughing repeatedly, and why would breathing not be easy for the child as it should be? What can be done about this situation?
model_answer: The child is likely suffering from severe pneumonia or another lower respiratory tract infection, which is caused by germs (bacteria or viruses) and not by cold water baths or exposure to cold air. Breathing becomes difficult because these germs cause the lungs' air sacs to fill with pus and fluid, hindering vital oxygen exchange. This is a medical emergency, so you must take the child to the nearest hospital or health centre immediately. At the hospital, the healthcare team will likely provide oxygen therapy, administer appropriate antibiotics, and ensure the child is well hydrated. To prevent this in the future, ensure the child receives all routine childhood immunizations, including the pneumococcal vaccine.

model_answer: The severe nighttime cough and breathing difficulty in your 8-month-old are likely caused by lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, bronchiolitis, or croup. Yes, these symptoms, especially when combined with fast breathing, are clear signs of a lung infection that requires urgent medical attention. Because the baby is now refusing to feed and is lethargic—critical danger signs in our setting—immediate evaluation at a hospital is vital. To help your baby feel more comfortable while seeking care, you can use saline nose drops to clear the nostrils, keep the head slightly elevated during sleep, and offer frequent breast milk to prevent dehydration. Please avoid giving over-the-counter cough syrups or self-prescribing antibiotics, as these can be very harmful to infants.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
Alamuuji ɗi mbinndi-ɗon ɗon — bee jooɗugo feere, luttugo haaju fijirde, e salaade nyaamdu — ɗon nandi sanne bee nyau ɓillaare ɓernde mawnde (depression) ko dammuɗum hakkilo. 

Ngam mballon mo, handi kuuton bee makko bee munyal, mbolon mo bee jooɗugo e makko, taa kujeenon mo kadi ngaddanon mo nyaamdu ɗum o yiɗi. 

Alamuuji kallaɗi ɗi mballata andugo o ɗon haaje likita law-law woni: to o ɗon haala dow accugo yonki makko, to o sala nyaamdu pat, ko to o nani bolle ɗe goɗɗo nanaay. 

Handi njaddon mo haa asibiti ngam o lara likita mo andi nyauuji hakkilo (psychiatrist) o heɓa maggal e shawariiji poottuɗi. 

Taa njaɓon o lutta feere makko, ngam wallitteego diga saare e sooba'en ɗon wallita sanne haa o warta bana no o woni nane.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tari jemma, fofungo e bone, e waɗugo lawo to keccel lebbirɗe tati woni alaamaaji caɗeele ɓalndu bana sotta-sotta (*bronchiolitis*) malla jofe (*pneumonia*). Ɗo ɓeydoo jemma ngam henndu peewri, bo salaade musingo e fofungo yaawgo woni maalle caɗeele mawɗe (*danger signs*) ɗe a fotai naftirgo lekki saare ngam maaje. Sey a yara mo asibiti mboɗɗum ngam likitoci nkesɗina mako mbalura fofungo (*oxygen*) malla lekki njaaje ngo mbonnata mako ɓalndu. To o ɗon fofa e bone, a wawan jooɗnaago e makko dadiiɗo (uuruɗo) ha gaandu ma ngam o heɓa helowgo fofungo banni bo a ɗon hokko mo ɓiraaɗam endu seɗɗa-seɗɗa. Hakkil e reenugo mo diga cuurki kuoral, peewri, e mbuure ngam o heɓa jam e ɗaano boɗɗum jemma.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Ɗon haaje jaawunde ɓe yara bingel ɗo asibiti jontajonta ngam heɓugo safande yaawunde ngam hisgo yonki mako. 

Ha asibiti, likitoci ɓasoto babal ngatande ɗon, ɓe ngana mo lekki kayeefi (*antibiotics*) ngam laɓɓingo dammutore e burtungo huynunde nde lekki gargajiya waddi. 

Bingel ɗo mari haaje heɓugo riga-kafi ciwo kaandi rawandu (*Rabies vaccine*) jontajonta, koo da rawandu ndun ɗon dama, ngam reitugo ciwo rawandu mbaroowo. 

Ɓe nangan mo kadi riga-kafi tamasari (*Tetanus vaccine*) ngam ta’eeki lekki gargajiya man be dudal dammutore ngun. 

Accee safande gargajiya ha ngatande rawandu jonta, ngam ciwo rawandu (*Rabies*) walaa lekki to o fuddi wadugo kuuje goɗɗe ha ɓandu.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Ɓingel maaɗa heɓi ko wi'etee *dimbugo ngam zazzabi* (febrile seizure), ko ɓuri saabeego bee zazzabi mbuuɓu (malaria) ha lardin meɗen. 

To ɗum waɗi, fudo mbilinaa ɓingel ngel ha wuttuldu (recovery position) dow leydi koo mbeela ngam ta o ɓuuta, kadi ta a waɗi koɗume fuu ha nder hunduko maako. 

Jippina zazzabi man bee pottol ngol a sulki ha ndiyam ɓulɗam (lukewarm water) a ɓuuɓna ɓandul maako, ammaa ta a fati mo ndiyam peewɗam masin. 

Ndillaa bee maako asibiti lawlaw ngam likit'en ndaara ko addi zazzabi man (bano malaria koo mbuuɓu ɓandu) ngam o heɓa safara potɗo. 

Ta a huutiri laabi mbonɗi bano loofuki ngaska koo naftirgo leɗɗe bee kine koo hunduko maako, ngam ɗum ɗon lannata yonki ɓiɗɗo.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Nyau nangiɗo ɓingel maada ɗum ko wi'etee giide (convulsions/seizures), bo ɗon heɓo saabi wulaandu ɓandu masin bana zazzaago (malaria) ko mborre kunu (meningitis). Yaaree ɓingel man asibiti jotta-jotta gam o heɓa batte (injections) bee lekkiiji dartintoojum giide ɗon bo safra ko waddi wulaandu ndon. Haba bee ta mbaddee lekkiiji gargajiya, sabulu gari, ko loope ha hunduko makko, gam ɗum ɗon maɓɓa laawol foofugo makko bo ɗon nawnan mo masin. Ko nanngee waɗugo jotta ko waalinki ɓingel ngel ha sengo gooto (recovery position) gam ɗiyam ɗon wurtoo ha hunduko makko bo o heɓa foofugo laaɓngum. Nyau ɗon maran dama masin to on yaari mo asibiti law gam heɓugo kure gonga.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer:
Ɗojjuru lebbi ɗiɗi e saɗeende fofugo jemma e ɓinngel duuɓi jowi ɗon holla alaamaaji astma (asthma) koo kadi nyau tibi (TB) mo heɓay lekki muɗum deydey. Astma ɗon addana datuuji henndu ɓinngel hiɗɗugo jemma, ɗum woni ko addanta mo fofugo saɗungo e ɗojjugo haa o uja. Lekki bana "Tutolin" wallataa ngam nyauji ɗi, kadi huutorgon maajum mardo haari ɗon lanna heɓugo maggal deydeyɗum. 

Ɗon haani njaa-ɗaa e makko haa asibiti ngam likita’en mbadana mo koonye bana "Chest X-ray" bee kadi binndigo ɗojjuru ngam tewtugo ngonka makko. To ɗum astma on, o heɓan lekki fofugo (inhaler) ngam udditgo datuuji henndu makko, boo to tibi on kadi o heɓan maggal potungal ngal o sellira.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi ngolluɗaa ha gorko maa—bana foofugo caɗtungol, ɗojjo duumiingo lebbi ɗiɗi, ɓiraawo saande, e yiisugo soolaji bee jaangol—ɗon holla caɗeele mawɗe bana ngilngu kaaba (Tuberculosis/TB) malla caɗeele ɓernde. 

Ngam maajum, ɗon haani njahen mo jooni-jooni ha sibiti (hospital) ngam o waɗe jarribaari talol (sputum test) e hotto gaba (chest X-ray) heɓa hefta ko nawni mo. 

Ta nattiree lekki majjaaki so doktoor winndanaay mo, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓesda caɗeele ɗon. 

To o heftaama bee ngilngu kaaba (TB), lekki mum ɗon heɓoo meere ha sibitiji laamu ammaa o yoɓataa ko mbuɗu, e ɗon sellina timmi. 

Hannde jooni, carree mo ha pellel henndu laɓɗum ɗon yaha, kuwtinee mo bee kolte ɗelɓe, njahee sibiti ngam o heɓa jam e jooɗande belɗum.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓaawo dayugo e nyawu mborodi (sepsis) ngam luttuɗe bofi walla ƴiiƴam boɓɓungo haa nder riga ɓiɗɗo on waddi ɓandu dada man wula, koɗse mako bo fewa, bo o rufu ƴiiƴam bee robe. Likita ɗon yiɗi laɓɓina (lota) nder riga ɓiɗɗo (uterus) mako ngam ittugo luttuɗe ɗen bo ɗum fadda rufugo ƴiiƴam e nyawu ngun. Min mbinndanay mo leɗɗe darnugo ƴiiƴam (batal ko kwaye), leɗɗe kuɓtinooje mborodi (antibiotics) e uurngo ndiyam (IV fluids) ngam darnugo ƴiiƴam man e yaɓugo zazzaure nden. Ngam o laɓi bo o somi sanne, o yiɗi heɓugo ƴiiƴam gurnol (blood transfusion) ngam sembe mako lorta, o wawa hakkilugo e ɓiɗɗo mako. Ɗum ɗon woni sabaabu gaddoojo mbariku (emergency), ngam man heɓugo nyawndagol parpar haa asibiti ɗon mari nafa sanne ngam hisnugo yonki dada man.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Ɓingel man ɗon njiimi caɗeele ɓillugo e luural fofugo (*birth asphyxia*) ngam danyugo ngo booyaay ko tetti sanne. Dimbugol ɓandu (*seizures*) e sellaay fofugo man ɗon holla wonde dital hoore ɓingel ngel heɓaay oksijin ko heyi wakkati danyugo. Hokkaago oksijin joni e kuurgal asbitila mari nafari sanne gam hisngo yonki ɓingel ngel e daggugo caɗeele hoore. To Allah walli o hisi, o waawan wongo e jam, amma ɗon mari damuwa dow heɓugo caɗeele dital hoore yeeso bana *cerebral palsy* ngam danyugo ngo tetti man. Likitocen ɗon huuwa ko handi, ngam man tokke umrooje maɓɓe fuu jooni ngam ɓingel ngel heɓa faabo.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
Fofugo jaawngo e caɗeele fofugo haa ɓiɗɗo petel woni maale nyaw mawnunde wano pneumonia malla sople, nden ɗum na heɓa ngam peewri. 

Accee yiwugo ɓiɗɗo bee diyam peewɗam, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda peewri ɓandu (hypothermia) kadi ɗum ɗon yaasi caɗeele fofugo maako. 

Yaaree ɓiɗɗo o asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita'en ndaara mo, mballa mo bee fofugo (oxygen) kadi ɓe ngena mo lekkiiji goonga. 

Ko njaahoton asibiti, kuurtee ɓiɗɗo oo bee kolte ɓulɗe ngam o heɓa ngulaandi ɓandu. 

Ta kuutoree lekkiiji ledɗe malla lekkiiji boɗeeji ɗi likita jootaayi ngam ta ɗum ɓeyda caɗeele ɓiɗɗo man.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɗum waawan laatago saabe maru danyugo (uterus) sunkitaaki (not contracting), ko boo saabe woodugo ɓingel goɗɗo luttuɗo nder reedu, ko luttuɗum ɓaltoore danyugo (placenta).

Ko addu kuugal, taba reedu debbo man ngam tabbitingo wala ɓingel ɗiɗabo luttuɗo, nden nyanndee (massage) reedu ndun sembe ngam wallitgo maru man sunkitoo darnugo iyam.

Hokkee mo batal *Oxytocin* (10 IU) ha dango (IM), ko boo kwaye *Misoprostol* (kwaye 4, 800mcg) ha les ɗemngal ko ha dango (rectal) ngam darnugo iyam man.

Konne mo iyam ɓaleele (IV fluids) bana *Normal Saline* ko *Ringer's Lactate* bee fetooji mawɗi (cannula) ngam sembiɗingo ɓandu maako ko taƴa sembe.

So tawreeta iyam ɗon sali darugo ɓawo wadugo kujeji ɗon, neldon mo asibiti mawɗo (referral) lawlaw ngam hisgo yonki maako.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: A woodi gonga ko a yardataako e haala "ndiyam naati hoore" man, ngam caɗeele foofugo e musungo e ɓingel duuɓi ɗiɗi naa ngam ndiyam on. Ɓikkon keccun e kine tan pofata wakkati musungo; to kine majjum sukki, e waawaa foofugo e musingo wakkati gootol, ɗum on waɗata o acca musingo. Ɗo ɗon nanda bee nyaw mbuuku (neonatal infection/sepsis) bee pewol ngol haandi likita’en ndaara ngam hisnugo yonki ɓingel man. Mi ɗon afora ma njaha suudu lekki (asibiti) jooni-jooni ngam likita’en kuuwa kine mako kadi ɓe korta mo lekki ngol natti nyaw man. Taa tiɗɗina mo o musa bee doole ngam o taa tuuta kosam man nden ɗum naata e kine mako naa ɓernde mako.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer: Ɓinngel maaɗon ɗon mari nyaw pofɗe keeso (severe pneumonia) e caɗeele pofde mawɗe, nden ɗum haajiri en nastina mo sibiti jotta ngam yaawre larde mo. Ta mbinɗane mo lekki ɗojugo ko maccine mo saare, ngam nyau man ɗon haɗa mo muusugo e pofde booɗɗum. Sey mboɗtan hokkaango mo lekki damba ko ndiyam dargo jotta, ngam ɗum waawan ɓeydugo caɗeele mako walla adda tooke nder ɓandu mako. Jotta haa sibiti ɗo, en puɗɗan hokkaango mo henndu pofde (oxygen) e lekki kurngilaaji (antibiotics) je mbelata mo bee yaawre. Kisndam ɓinngel ɗo ɗon tabiti nder yaawre nastingo mo sibiti e hoosa kuuje hakkilango mo bee yaawre ngam hisgo yonki mako.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
reference:
Min yi goto der rewbe Amin marbe redu beh gorko mako fijjiri doh, ovi les jaburu mako beh bawo mako do nawa, beh wakkati daigol mako yottai fuu. Min emimo redu mako lebbi noi on? Ovi lebbi jego beh balde sedda on. Min emimo toh do nawa mo jotta ko do wara dilla on, sei ovi do nawa mo jotta. Sei min emimo toh olari diyam ko iyam, ovi olari diyam beh iyam. Min emimo bo bingel man jeh lamba noi on, bo redu man jeh noi on? Sei ovi hanjum on je arande. Emol min marni likita men hanjum on ; do alama daigol yotti onna, o fukkiri na, ko hunde fere on?
Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer:
Sannu, ɗum ɗon holla wonde debbo o ɗon mari matsala mawɗo ngam lebbi jego bee balɗe seɗɗa naa wakkati jibinol yotti ya, ɗum ɗon yiɗi yahdu asibiti ɗon-ɗon. 

Ndiyam bee iyam ɗon wurta bee nawoore reedu ɗon holla alama luttugo reedu bako wakkati (preterm labor) malla matsala bee heɓre ɓiɗɗo (placenta). 

Eyyi, nafi ɗon heɓugo scan (ultrasound) ɗon-ɗon ngam likita’en lara no ɓiɗɗo man bee ndiyam mum ngoniri nder reedu. 

Min ɗon ma’ina on kootton asibiti mawɗo ngam heɓugo wallitoore bee law, ta kuutan kuuje saare walla fukkiigo ha saare. 

Tokkugo asibiti law waawan hisgo yonki debbo man bee ɓiɗɗo nder reedu mako.

question: titi lola daga ɓandu bingel am do fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man metatatata wailutuggo gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dume on wawata godda zazzabi do be bo ko hadata dande mako golto handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako watuggo jawabu toy be yeccata men je ko woyla bandu bingel man je wadata zazzabi be ko hadata mako wanko.

model_answer: The baby's symptoms of exhaustion, heavy sweating during feeding, and labored breathing are classic signs of congestive heart failure, often due to an underlying congenital heart defect (like a "hole in the heart"), or a severe lung infection. Sweating occurs because breastfeeding is a major physical workout for an infant, and a struggling heart or lung forces the baby's sympathetic nervous system into overdrive to cope with the exertion. The abnormal "upward and downward" breathing is indeed a serious sign of respiratory distress, showing that the baby is exhausting their muscles just to get enough oxygen. Parents must immediately watch for critical danger signs like bluish lips or tongue (cyanosis), deep drawing-in of the chest under the ribs, a grunting sound with every breath, or extreme sleepiness where the baby cannot wake up. This is a medical emergency, and the baby must be rushed to a hospital immediately for a proper pediatric examination, chest X-ray, and heart scan (echocardiogram).

Wata rana, bayan mijinta ya yi dogon tari yana ta ƙoƙarin samun numfashinsa daidai, matar ta fara damuwa. Ta fara tunanin ko wata cuta ce ke haddasa duk waɗannan matsaloli. Washegari, ta yi magana da mijinta suka yanke shawarar zuwa asibiti domin likita ya duba shi kuma a gano ainihin abin da ke damunsa.
Tambayar ita ce: Mene ne zai iya sa tari ya kasance mai tsanani haka, tare da yawan gajiya da wahalar numfashi a duk lokacin da tarin ya taso? Shin wannan matsala tana da alaƙa ne kawai da cututtukan huhu ko cututtukan zuciya? Waɗanne cututtuka ko matsaloli ne za su iya jawo mutuwa ko kuma su sa mutum ya shiga matsananciyar wahalar numfashi har ya buƙaci kulawar gaggawa? Kuma waɗanne alamomin haɗari ne game da tari da wahalar numfashi da ya kamata iyali su lura da su domin a garzaya da mara lafiyan zuwa asibiti?
model_answer:
Wadannan matsaloli na iya kasancewa sanadiyyar cututtukan huhu (kamar taruba/TB ko toshewar hanyoyin numfashi) ko kuma na zuciya (kamar gazawar zuciya/Heart Failure), domin duka sassan biyu suna aiki tare wajen numfashi. Gajiya da wahalar numfashi yayin ɗan takaitaccen motsi na nuna cewa jikin ba ya samun isasshen iskar oxygen, kuma duka cututtukan biyu na iya yin tsanani har su kai ga mutuwa idan ba a kula da su ba. Matsaloli kamar tsananin gazawar zuciya, toshewar jini a huhu (pulmonary embolism), da matsanancin ciwon huhu (pneumonia) sune ke iya kawo matsananciyar wahala da ke buƙatar agajin gaggawa. 

Alamomin haɗari da ya kamata iyali su kula da su don kai shi asibiti nan take sun haɗa da: tari mai ɗauke da jini, matsanancin zafin ƙirji, kumburin ƙafafu, leɓuna ko yatsun da suka zama shuɗi, da kuma rashin iya magana gabaɗaya saboda ƙarancin numfashi. Ina ba su shawarar su ziyarci asibiti mafi kusa cikin gaggawa domin likita ya yi masa gwaje-gwaje kamar hoton ƙirji (X-ray) da na zuciya (ECG) don gano cutar da wuri da fara magani.

question: Ni matar aure mai shekaru 35 don Allah na kawo jaririna mai watanni 5 domin a bincika shi kuma a ba ni shawara na koma bakin aiki amma abin mamaki kusan kwanaki 3 da suka wuce na lura. cewa jaririna yana yin tari akai-akai mun gwada duk abin da za mu iya tunani a kai don tsaida tarin amma ina iya ganin cewa tarin bai ɓace ba yawanci ba na zama a gida lokacin da na fita da safe ba na dawowa sai wajen ƙarfe shi. na yamma mahaifiyata tana zama a gida tare da jaririn duk lokacin da na sami damar yin kira ina yi kuma ina tambaya game da tari sai su ci gaba da gaya mani cewa jaririn yana nan yana tari jaririn yana da watanni 5 ba. Ba ya sake shan nono kaɗai domin na koma bakin aiki na ba shi nono na tsawon watanni 3 kuma bayan haka na fara ba shi wasu abinci da nono da sauran sauran abincin jarirai da na sani abin da ya fi ba da mamaki shine tun dare numfashinsa bai kasance daidai ba ya numfashi da kyau kuma hancinsa ya toshe gaba ɗaya Mahaifiyata ma ta ce lokacin da take yi masa wanka da safen nan sai da ta yi amfani da ɗan ruwan zafi a kewayon hancinsa da kirjinsa saboda tarin ya yi tsanani matsalar numfashin ma ta fara ba ya sake yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma numfashinsa ba shi da tsari. da walwala kuma yanzu don Allah tambayata ita ce menene zan iya amfani da shi don shi domin tsaida tarin kuma game da numfashin da ba shi da tsarki kuma me zan iya yi menene zan iya amfani da shi don shi? Kuma waɗanne matakai zan iya ɗauka yadda zai rika yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma babu abin da zai toshe numfashinsa?
reference:
Ni matar aure ce, mai shekaru talatin da biyar. Don Allah, na kawo jaririna mai watanni biyar domin a bincika shi kuma a ba ni shawara.
Na koma bakin aiki. Amma abin mamaki, kusan kwanaki uku da suka wuce, na lura cewa jaririna yana yin tari akai-akai. Mun gwada duk abin da za mu iya tunani akai don tsaida tarin, amma ina iya ganin cewa tarin bai bace ba.
Yawanci ba na zama a gida. Lokacin da na fita da safe, ba na dawowa sai wajen karfe 6 na yamma. Mahaifiyata tana zama a gida tare da jaririn.
Duk lokacin da na sami damar yin kira, ina yi kuma ina tambaya game da tarin, sai su ci gaba da gaya mini cewa jaririn yana nan yana tari.
Jaririn yana da watanni biyar. Ba ya sake shan nono kadai domin na koma bakin aiki. Na ba shi nono zalla na tsawon watanni uku, kuma bayan haka na fara ba shi wasu abinci daban.
Ina ba shi abinci daban-daban, wadanda suka hada da kunu  da sauran abincin jarirai da na sani.
Abin da ya fi ba da mamaki shi ne tun daddare, numfashinsa bai kasance daidai ba. Ba ya numfashi da kyau, kuma hancinsa ya toshe gaba daya.
Mahaifiyata ma ta ce lokacin da take yi masa wanka da safe nan, sai da ta yi amfani da dan ruwan zafi a kewayen hancinsa da kirjinsa saboda tarin ya yi tsanani.
Matsalar numfashin ma ta fara. Ba ya sake yin numfashi yadda ya kamata, kuma numfashinsa ba shi da tsarki da walwala kuma yanzu.
Don Allah, tambayata ita ce: mene ne zan iya amfani da shi don shi domin tsaida tarin? Kuma game da numfashin da ba shi da tsarki kuma, me zan iya yi, mene ne zan iya amfani da shi don shi, kuma wadanne matakai zan iya dauka yadda zai rika yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma babu abin da zai toshe numfashinsa
model_answer:
Sannu uwa, alamun da kika kwatanta kamar wahalar numfashi da rashin tsarin numfashi a jariri mai watanni 5 alamomi ne na gaggawa da ke nuna yiwuwar kamuwa da cutar huhu (kamar pneumonia), don haka dole ne ku garzaya asibiti mafi kusa maza-maza. 

Kada ki kuskura ki ba shi kowane irin maganin tari na kanti ko na gargajiya, domin yin hakan yana da matukar hadari ga jarirai 'yan kasa da shekaru biyu kuma yana iya dagula numfashinsa. 

Domin bude hancinsa da ya toshe kafin ku isa asibiti, kuna iya amfani da ruwan gishiri na hanci na musamman (saline nasal drops) don digawa a hancinsa, sannan ku guji amfani da ruwan zafi a kirjinsa domin fatarsa tana da taushi sosai kuma tana iya konewa. 

Haka kuma, dakatar da shayar da nono zalla kafin watanni shida ya rage masa garkuwar jiki da ke kare shi daga cututtukan numfashi, don haka ci gaba da ba shi nonon uwa a yanzu zai taimaka masa sosai. 

Don Allah kada ku jinkirta a gida; gaggauta kaita shi asibiti shi ne kadai zai ba likitoci damar duba shi, su ba shi iskar oxygen idan yana bukata, kuma su ba shi maganin da ya dace don ceton rayuwarsa.

question: Wata uwa mai shayarwa ta lura cewa ɗanta yana tare sannan ta yi zargin cewa jikin yaron yana yin zafi a wasu lokuta. Ta ci gaba da cewa sa'o'i kaɗan da suka gabata ta gaba ɗaya jikin yaron ya yi ƙarfi ya yi kame sannan ta suma. Ta kuma lura cewa kumfa ko ruwa yana fita daga bakinsa kuma yaron ya daina iya haɗiye abinci ko abin. Shin Sha yanzu tana tambayar likita ko irin wannan ciwo yana da magani wace irin cuta ce yake kamu da ita sannan tana tambaya ko za a iya ba yaron allura ko kuma a yi amfani da magungunan gargajiya wajen magance wannan ciwo ta kara da cewa a unguwan da ta fito idan irin wannan ciwo ya kama yaro abin da suka fi amfani da shi shine maganin gargajiya abbo da kuma sabulun? Garga jiya.
reference:
Wata uwa mai shayarwa ta lura cewa ɗanta yana tari, sannan ta yi zargin cewa jikin yaron yana yin zafi a wasu lokuta. Ta ci gaba da cewa, sa'o'i kaɗan da suka gabata, ta ga gaba ɗaya jikin yaron ya yi ƙarfi (ya yi ƙame), sannan ta suma. Ta kuma lura cewa kumfa ko ruwa yana fita daga bakinsa, kuma yaron ya daina iya haɗiye abinci ko abin sha.
Yanzu tana tambayar likita ko irin wannan ciwo yana da magani, wace irin cuta ce yake kama da ita, sannan tana tambaya ko za a iya ba yaron allura ko kuma a yi amfani da magungunan gargajiya wajen magance wannan ciwo. Ta ƙara da cewa a unguwar da ta fito, idan irin wannan ciwo ya kama yaro, abin da suka fi amfani da shi shi ne maganin gargajiya (agbo) da kuma sabulun gargajiya.
model_answer:
Wannan matsalar da jaririn yake ciki alamun farfadiyar zazzabi ce (febrile convulsion) ko kuma cututtuka masu tsanani kamar sankarau (meningitis) ko tetanus, kuma yana buƙatar kulawar gaggawa a asibiti nan take. E, wannan cutar tana da cikakken magani a asibiti ta hanyar amfani da allurai da sauran magunguna na zamani da za su tsayar da kame jikin sannan su warkar da ainihin abin da ya kawo zazzabin. 

Ina ba ku shawara mai ƙarfi da ku guji amfani da maganin gargajiya kamar "abbo" ko sabulun gargajiya, domin ba su da ingancin kimiyya kuma suna iya cutar da huhun yaron, sa shi shaƙar numfashi mai guba, ko kuma jinkirta samun maganin da zai ceto rayuwarsa. Lokacin da yaron yake kame, kada a tilasta masa haɗiye komai ko zuba masa ruwa a baki, sai dai a kwantar da shi ta gefe guda domin kumfa ko aman su samu damar fita ba tare da sun toshe masa makogwaro ba. Don Allah ku hanzarta kai yaron asibiti mafi kusa yanzu domin a ceto rayuwarsa kafin lokaci ya kure.

question: Wata mata mai juna biyu ta zo asibiti da yammacin yau. Ta bayyana cewa mijinta yana yawan yi mata ihu kuma sau da yawa yana dukanta. Yanzu tana son ta san:

Wane irin taimako ko abin da za ta iya yi ne zai taimaka mata ta dawo da kwanciyar hankali, natsuwa, da lafiyar zuciyarta da tunaninta?
model_answer:
Mafi mahimmanci shi ne ki daina amfani da maganin gargajiya kuma ki gaggauta ganin likita ko ungozoma domin duba hawan jinin ki, saboda damuwa da cin zarafi a lokacin juna biyu na iya haifar da hawan jini mai haɗari ga rayuwarki da ta jaririn.

Idan kika ji tsoro ko fargaba na shirin mamaye ki lokacin da mijinki zai dawo, ki zauna a nitse ki riƙa yin dogon numfashi ta hanci kina fitarwa ta baki a hankali (deep breathing) domin rage saurin bugun zuciya da kwantar da hankali.

Yana da matukar mahimmanci ki samar da tsarin tsira (safety plan) ta hanyar neman mafaka a gidan iyayenki ko amintattun 'yan uwa don nesanta kanki daga duka da barazana yayin da ake cikin wannan yanayi.

Zan ba ki shawarar ki nemi ganin ƙwararre a fannin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa (counselor) a asibiti domin ya taimake ki da hanyoyin magance fargaba (anxiety) da kuma dawo miki da natsuwar zuciya.

Kada ki yi shiru da wannan matsalar; ki sanar da ma'aikatan lafiya na asibitin da kika je domin su haɗa ki da jami'an jin daɗin jama'a (social workers) ko ƙungiyoyin da ke kare haƙƙin mata masu fuskantar cin zarafi a gida don samun kariya ta doka da ta lafiya.

Sannu uwar gida, jaririnki yana nuna alamun cutar numfashi mai tsanani kamar *Bronchiolitis* ko ciwon huhu (*Pneumonia*), wanda ke sa shi numfashi mai sautin busa.

question: Mun ga wata mata mai juna biyu da sassafe yau tare da mijinta tace tana fama da matsanancin ciwo a cikinta sannan bayanta ma yana mata ciwo duk da cewa lokacin haihuwarta bai yi ba tukuna. Mun tambaye ta wata nawa take da ciki sai ta ce tana da ciki na wata 6 da wasu kwanaki sai muka sake tambayarta ko ciwon yana nan a lokacin ko kuma yana zuwa yana tafiya sai ta ce ciwon yana nan akai-akai. Daga nan muka tambaye ta ko ta ga ru. Ruwa ko jini yana fitowa daga gabanta sai ta ce eh ta ga ruwa da kuma jini. Mun kuma tambaye ta wannan ciki na nawa ne gare ta sai ta ce wannan ne cikinta na farko? Tambayar mu ga likita ita ce. Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa naƙuda ta fara ne kafin lokaci haihuwa da wuri ko kuma suna iya nuna cewa cikin ya lalace zubar da ciki ko kuwa wata matsala ce daban? Shin za mu iya ba wannan matan shawarar ta je ayi mata hoton ciki domin a gano abin da ke faruwa?
reference:
Mun ga wata mata mai juna biyu da sassafe yau tare da mijinta. Ta ce tana fama da matsanancin ciwo a cikinta, sannan bayanta ma yana mata ciwo, duk da cewa lokacin haihuwarta bai yi ba tukuna.
Mun tambaye ta wata nawa take da ciki, sai ta ce tana da ciki na wata shida da wasu kwanaki.
Sai muka sake tambayarta ko ciwon yana nan a lokacin ko kuma yana zuwa yana tafiya, sai ta ce ciwon yana nan a kai a kai.
Daga nan muka tambaye ta ko ta ga ruwa ko jini yana fitowa daga gabanta, sai ta ce eh, ta ga ruwa da kuma jini. Mun kuma tambaye ta wannan ciki na nawa ne gare ta, sai ta ce wannan ne cikinta na farko.
Tambayarmu ga likita ita ce: Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa nakuda ta fara ne kafin lokaci (haihuwa da wuri), ko kuma suna iya nuna cewa cikin ya lalace (zubar da ciki), ko kuwa wata matsala ce daban? Shin za mu iya ba wannan matan shawarar ta je a yi mata hoton ciki domin a gano abin da ke faruwa?
model_answer:
Waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna barazanar rabuwar mahaifa kafin lokaci (*placental abruption*) ko kuma naƙuda kafin lokaci (*preterm labor*) tare da fashewar jakar ruwan ciki, maimakon zubar da ciki na al'ada tunda cikin ya riga ya kai wata shida. Ciwon baya da ciki akai-akai tare da zubar jini da ruwa yana buƙatar kulawa ta gaggawa saboda yana iya barazana ga rayuwar uwar da ta jaririn. 

E, lallai yana da matuƙar muhimmanci a ba ta shawarar yin hoton ciki (*ultrasound scan*) cikin gaggawa domin a gano asalin matsalar, lafiyar jaririn, da kuma yanayin mahaifar. Don haka, muna ba ku shawarar ku garzaya da ita ba tare da ɓata lokaci ba zuwa babban asibiti mafi kusa da ke da kwararrun likitocin mata da na kula da jarirai domin ceto rayuwarsu.

question: Wata mata ta haihu a asibitin kimanin watanni 6 da suka gabata yanzu ta dawo asibitin tare da mijinta da jaririyarsu mai watanni 6. Wata mata ta haihu a asibitinmu kimanin watanni shida da suka gabata. Yanzu ta dawo asibitin tare da mijinta da jaririyarsu mai watanni shida.
Mahaifiyar ta bayyana cewa kimanin kwanaki goma sha uku zuwa goma sha huɗu da suka gabata ne ta fara lura cewa jaririyar ta fara tari. Ta kuma ce tun kafin tari ya fara, tana yi wa jaririyar maganin mura.
Ta ce tun jiya tari ya ƙara tsananta sosai. Duk da cewa tari ya fara ƙaruwa tun kusan kwanaki uku da suka gabata, amma tun jiya ya zama mai tsanani ƙwarai.
Ta ce duk lokacin da take shayar da jaririyar nono, tana kuma ba ta wani maganin tari na ruwa da ake sayarwa a cikin kwalba, wanda take ci gaba da ba ta.
Sai ta ƙara da cewa tun daga jiya, tari ya yi tsanani matuƙa har ya sa jaririyar tana fama sosai wajen numfashi. Numfashinta yana kamar yana hauhawa da saukowa cikin ƴan daƙiƙu kaɗan-kaɗan, abin da ya tayar musu da hankali ƙwarai.
Saboda tsananin fargaba ne suka kawo jaririyar asibiti.
Tambaya ita ce: Shin za mu iya ba wannan uwa wani magani da za ta ba jaririyar a gida, alhali tana fama da wahalar numfashi tare da wannan tari? Shin ya dace mu rubuta mata maganin tari kawai, ko kuwa ya kamata a fara cikakken duba jaririyar kafin a rubuta kowane irin magani ko a yi mata allura?
model_answer:
A'a, kwata-kwata bai dace a rubuta maganin tari kawai ko a ba uwar maganin da za ta tafi da shi gida ba; dole ne a gaggauta yin cikakken binciken lafiyar jaririyar a asibiti nan take. Wadannan alamomi na wahalar numfashi da saurin fashin da yake hauhawa da sauka ga jaririya mai watanni 6 suna nuna tana da matsananciyar cutar numfashi (kamar "pneumonia" ko "bronchiolitis") wadda ke bukatar kwantarwa a asibiti da gaggawa. 

Bugu da kari, ba da magungunan tari na kwalba ga jariri dan kasa da shekaru biyu yana da hadari sosai domin suna iya dakatar da numfashinsa, kuma hukumar lafiya ta duniya (WHO) ta haramta hakan. A tsarin gudanar da lafiyar yara na kasashenmu (IMCI), jaririn da ke da wadannan alamomin yana bukatar auna yawan iskar oxygen a jikinsa (pulse oximetry), a duba idan kirjinsa yana loba (chest indrawing), kuma a ba shi tallafin iskar oxygen da magungunan allura idan bukatar hakan ta taso. Don haka, kada ku rubuta kowane magani har sai an duba ta daki-daki domin ceto rayuwarta.

question: Wani mai kula da yaro ya lura cewa yaron yana tari mai tsanani har tari yana katse masa numfashi kuma yana fama da wahalar numfashi. Me zai iya sa yaro ya yi irin wannan tari mai tsanani har ya kasa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata? Wadanne gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa wannan yaro domin gano matsalar? Wane irin magani ne za a ba shi kuma wace shawara ce ya kamata a ba mai kula da wannan yaro?
reference: Wani mai kula da yaro ya lura cewa yaron yana tari mai tsanani, har tari yana katse masa numfashi kuma yana fama da wahalar numfashi. Me zai iya sa yaro ya yi irin wannan tari mai tsanani har ya kasa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata? Wadanne gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa wannan yaro domin gano matsalar? Wane irin magani ne za a ba shi? Kuma wace shawara ce ya kamata a ba mai kula da wannan yaro?
model_answer: Wannan tari mai tsanani da ke katse numfashi yana iya zama sanadiyyar cutar tari-sheka (Pertussis) ko kuma ciwon huhu mai tsanani (pneumonia). Domin gano ainihin matsalar, ana bukatar yin gwajin jini (FBC), gwajin majinar makogwaro (nasopharyngeal swab), da kuma hoton kirji (Chest X-ray). Ana magance wannan rashin lafiya ta hanyar amfani da magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta (kamar Azithromycin) da kuma ba da iskar oxygen idan numfashi ya yi matukar wahala. Ina ba mai kula da yaron shawarar ya raba shi da sauran yara don guje wa yaduwar cutar, sannan ya gaggauta kai shi asibiti mafi kusa don samun kulawar gaggawa. Daga karshe, ya kamata a tabbatar yaron ya sami cikakkun alluran riga-kafi (Pentavalent vaccine) don kariya daga sake kamuwa da cutar a nan gaba.

model_answer: Alamomin da kika bayyana na tsananin ciwon kai, taurin wuya, da kuraje a jiki suna nuni da yiwuwar kamuwa da cutar sankarau (meningitis), wacce ke da matukar hadari a yankunanmu na Afirka. Sannan, yana da kyau ku kiyaye tsafta da guje wa kusanci da miyau ko tari yayin tafiya asibiti, domin wasu nau'ikan sankarau din suna iya yaduwa ga wasu mutanen.

model_answer:
Wadannan alamomin da mijinki yake da su, musamman yawan fitsari da kishirwa, gajiya, da disashen gani, suna nuna alamun cutar siga (Diabetes Mellitus) ne sosai, inda jiki ke kasa sarrafa sukari don samar da kuzari. Yana jin gajiya saboda rashin shigar sukarin cikin sel don samar da makamashi, yayin da yawan sukari a jini ke janyo yawan fitsari (don fitar da sukarin) da kuma disashen gani.

Ya kamata ya guje wa ababen sha masu zaki, sikari, da abinci mai sitaci da yawa (kamar farar shinkafa da fulawa), yayin da yake cin ganyayyaki, hatsi maras surfe (kamar barci ko jona), da shan ruwa marar zaki. Bayan an fara magani, ya kamata a rika duba sukarin jini da hawan jini akai-akai (kamar kowane wata ko yadda likita ya tsara) don kiyaye faruwar wasu matsalolin na daban.

question: Na kai wata ƙawata mai juna biyu mai shekara 18 zuwa asibiti domin naƙudarta ta kama kuma lokacin haihuwarta ya yi da muka isa asibitin bayan likitoci sun gudanar da dukan gwaje-gwajen da suka dace sai aka gano cewa hawan jininta ya yi yawa. Bayan an kammala duk abin da ya kamata a yi naƙudarta ta ci gaba ta shafe kusan awa 12 tana naƙuda. Mijinta yana kusa sai likitoci. Ana ba da shawarar cewa ta amince a yi mata tiyatar haihuwa saboda ta dade sosai tana naƙuda amma ƙawata ta ƙi tace a'a ko kadan. Ina so in haihu ta hanyar farji kamar matan Ibraniyawa daga ƙarshe ta haihu bayan awa 12 tana naƙuda ta haifi jaririya mace mai kama da lafiya kuma muka gode wa Allah amma abin da ya ba mu. mamaki shine jaririyar ba ta numfashi yadda ya kamata. Ma'aikatan lafiya suka ci gaba da motsa ta hanyar shafawa da dukan bayanta a hankali. Ta yi kuka amma har yanzu numfashinta bai daidaita ba nan da nan suka ba ta iskar oxygen. Likita don Allah wannan jaririya za ta rayu kuwa kuma idan ta rayu shin ba za ta iya samun nakasa ba?
reference: Na kai wata kawata mai juna biyu mai shekara goma sha takwas zuwa asibiti domin naƙudarta ta kama, kuma lokacin haihuwarta ya yi. Da muka isa asibitin, bayan likitoci sun gudanar da dukkan gwaje-gwajen da suka dace, sai aka gano cewa hawan jininta ya yi yawa. Bayan an kammala duk abin da ya kamata a yi, naƙudarta ta ci gaba. Ta shafe kusan awa goma sha biyu tana naƙuda. Mijinta yana kusa, sai likitoci suka ba da shawarar cewa ta amince a yi mata tiyatar haihuwa saboda ta daɗe sosai tana naƙuda. Amma kawata ta ƙi. Ta ce, "A'a, ko kaɗan. Ina so in haihu ta hanyar farji kamar matan Ibraniyawa." Daga ƙarshe ta haihu. Bayan awa goma sha biyu tana naƙuda, ta haifi jaririya mace mai kama da lafiyayyiya, kuma muka gode wa Allah. Amma abin da ya ba mu mamaki shi ne, jaririyar ba ta numfashi yadda ya kamata. Ma'aikatan lafiya suka ci gaba da motsa ta ta hanyar shafawa da dukan bayanta a hankali. Ta yi kuka, amma har yanzu numfashinta bai daidaita ba. Nan da nan suka ba ta iskar oxygen. Likita, don Allah, wannan jaririya za ta rayu kuwa? Kuma idan ta rayu, shin ba za ta iya samun nakasa ba?
model_answer: Rayuwar jaririyar da kuma yiwuwar samun nakasa a nan gaba sun dogara ne kacokan a kan tsawon lokacin da kwakwalwarta ta kwashe ba tare da isasshen iskar oxygen ba (wato *birth asphyxia*) saboda tsawon lokacin da aka dauka ana nakuda. Tunda har ta yi kuka kuma tana karbar iskar oxygen a yanzu, akwai kyakkyawan fatan za ta rayu muddin aka ci gaba da kula da ita sosai a sashen kula da jarirai na musamman (SCBU). Sai dai kuma, tana iya fuskantar hadarin samun nakasar kwakwalwa ko jinkirin girma da koyon abubuwa (kamar cutar *Cerebral Palsy*) idan har kwakwalwarta ta sha wahala sosai kafin ta fito. Saboda haka, yana da matukar muhimmanci likitocin yara su ci gaba da duba lafiyarta, kuma a rika bibiyar ci gaban girmanta akai-akai bayan kun bar asibiti. Daga karshe, muna ba da shawarar uwaye su guji kin amincewa da tiyatar haihuwa lokacin da likitoci suka bayyana bukatar hakan, domin tiyata hanya ce ta ceto rayuwar uwa da jinjiri ba wai gazawa ba ce.

question: Wata mai kula da ƙaramin yaro ta lura cewa yaron da take kulawa yana fama da wahalar numfashi kuma numfashinsa ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata. model_answer: Wadannan alamomin na nuna cewa yaron na iya samun cutar sanyin ƙirji (Pneumonia), ashema (Asthma), ko tari sheka wanda kwayoyin cuta (bacteria ko virus) ke haifarwa a cikin huhu. model_answer: Wannan tari mai tsanani da ƙarar ƙirji musamman da dare na iya zama sanadiyyar cutar asma (asthma), kumburin mashakar numfashi (bronchiolitis), ko kuma ciwon huhu (pneumonia). Don kariya da rage wannan tari, ya kamata a guji fallasa yaron ga hayakin girki na itace, hayakin taba, kura, turare mai ƙarfi, da kuma sanyin dare ko iskar fanka kai-tsaye. Ina ba ku shawarar ku kai yaron asibiti cikin gaggawa domin likitoci su duba shi, su ba shi magungunan da suka dace kamar na buɗe mashakar numfashi, kuma a tabbatar yana samun isasshen ruwan dumi ko nono.

question: Wata mata mai juna biyu mai ciki wata shida da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa zuciyarta tana bugawa da sauri sosai kamand mutum da ya gama gudu wani lokaci kuma tana jin gajiya sosai ba tare da ta yi wani aiki ba sannan hannayenta suna ɗan rawa kadan bayan wasu makonni ta kuma lura cewa wuyanta ya fara kumbura a gaba da mutane suka fara gaya mata cewa wuyan. ta ya canza kuma ya kumbura fiye da da sai ta tsorata ƙwarai. Wata mata mai juna biyu mai ciki wata shida da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa zuciyarta tana bugawa da sauri sosai, kamar mutum da ya gama gudu. Wani lokaci kuma tana jin gajiya sosai ba tare da ta yi wani aiki ba, sannan hannayenta suna ɗan rawa kaɗan.
Bayan wasu makonni, ta kuma lura cewa wuyanta ya fara kumbura a gaba. Da mutane suka fara gaya mata cewa wuyanta ya canza kuma ya kumbura fiye da da, sai ta tsorata ƙwarai. Ta fara tunanin ko wannan wata cuta ce da ke shafar mata masu juna biyu ko kuwa wata matsala ce dabam. Yanzu ta yanke shawarar zuwa ganin likita domin a gano abin da ke jawo wannan matsala.
Tambayata ita ce: Me zai iya sa zuciyar mace mai juna biyu ta rika bugawa da sauri kamar wadda ta gama gudu, tare da kumburin wuya? model_answer: Wadannan alamomin na bugun zuciya da sauri, rawar hannu, da kumburin wuya suna nuni ne ga cutar *hyperthyroidism* (inda gurgun makogwaro ke fitar da sinadarai fiye da kima), wanda ke bukatar kulawar likita cikin gaggawa. Wannan matsalar na iya shafar jariri ta hanyar janyo haihuwar bakwaini ko rashin girma yadda ya kamata, don haka sai a sa ido a gida kan alamomin hadari kamar zubar jini ta gaba, ciwon ciki mai tsanani, zazzabi mai zafi, ko raguwar motsin jariri a ciki. Game da abinci, ya kamata ta guji abubuwan sha masu sinadarin *caffeine* (kamar shayi ko kofi) da kuma cin gishiri ko abinci mai sinadarin iodine da yawa, domin suna iya kara tsananta bugun zuciya da kumburin. Maimakon haka, ta fi mayar da hankali kan cin abinci mai gina jiki mai wadata da sinadarin calcium da furotin kamar kwai, kifi, madara, da kayan lambu don taimakawa girman jariri. Ina ba ta shawarar ta gaggauta zuwa asibiti mafi kusa domin yin gwajin jini na *thyroid function test* domin a fara ba ta maganin da ya dace cikin aminci.

question: An kawo wata mata asibiti da safiyar yau saboda tana zubar da jini mai yawa kuma hakan ya jawo mata matsananciyar damuwa. An tambaye ta ko wannan ya taɓa faruwa da ita a baya sai ta ce eh ya taɓa faruwa kusan sau biyu inda take jin ciwo sannan zubar jinin yana zuwa lokaci-lokaci. model_answer: Abubuwan da ke iya sa mace zubar jini haka sun haɗa da barin ciki (miscarriage), cikin da ke wajen mahaifa (ectopic pregnancy), ko kuma matsalar mahaifa kamar sanyin mahaifa (PID) da fibroids. Gwaje-gwajen gaggawa da ya kamata a yi cikin hanzari sun haɗa da gwajin ciki (Pregnancy test), gwajin adadin jini (FBC/PCV), neman jinin ƙarin da ya dace (Blood group and Cross-match), da kuma hoton scan na mahaifa (Pelvic Ultrasound scan) domin gano ainihin matsalar.

question: Wata uwa daga cikin iyayen dalibi suke kawo jariransu don yin allurar rigakafi ta bayyana cewa ta lura jaririnta sabon haihuwa yana da matsala a kewayen baki kuma leben jaririn suna bayyana da ɗan kore kore yau kuma ta lura cewa. question: Wata mata da ke zaune a unguwarmu tana da ciki na ɗanta na biyu. model_answer: Matsanancin ciwon ƙasan ciki da zubar jini yayin juna biyu na iya faruwa sakamakon rabuwar mahaifa kafin lokaci (*placental abruption*), barazanar bari (*miscarriage*), ko kuma matsalar mahaifa. Lallai zubar jini mai yawa babbar alamar haɗari ce da ke barazana ga rayuwar uwa da jariri, saboda yana iya rage jini da iskar oxygen da ke zuwa ga jaririn tare da jefa uwar cikin mawuyacin hali na rashin jini. Sauran alamomin haɗari da ke nuna ciki yana cikin matsala sun haɗa da daukewar motsin jariri, jiri ko suma, zazzabi mai zafi, da kuma fita ruwa ta gaba kafin lokacin haihuwa. Babu wani takamaiman magani a gida da mutum zai iya sha da kansa wanda zai dakatar da wannan ciwo da zubar jinin cikin aminci ba tare da cutar da jariri ba. A asibiti ne kawai likitoci za su iya tantance ainihin matsalar ta hanyar hoton duban ɗan tayi (*ultrasound*) sannan su ba da kulawar gaggawa ko magungunan da suka dace domin ceton rayuwar uwa da jariri.

question: Sunana Titilola tun jiya jiki na dana yana zafi sosai kuma yana karkarwa sosai. Yaron baya iya wuyansa kwata kwata kamar wuyansa yayi tauri baya iya juyawa. model_answer:
Sannu Titilola. Wadannan alamomi na zazzabi mai zafi, rawar jiki, taurin wuya, da rashin iya bude ido daya suna nuni ne ga cutar sankarau (meningitis) ko kuma zazzabin cizon sauro mai tsanani da ya shafi kwakwalwa (cerebral malaria), wadanda ke zama ruwan dare a kasarmu. 

Babban gwajin da ya kamata a yi shi ne gwajin ruwan gadon baya (Lumbar Puncture/CSF analysis) domin a duba lafiyar kwakwalwa, tare da gwajin jinin cutar cizon sauro (MP test) da kuma cikakken gwajin jini (FBC). 

Idan sankarau ce ta kwayoyin cuta (bacterial meningitis), sakamakon gwajin ruwan gadon bayan zai iya nuna dushewar launi, karuwar fararen jini da sunadarin 'protein', raguwar sukari (glucose), da kuma bayyanar kwayoyin cutar kansu. 

Saboda tsananin wadannan alamomin, musamman matsalar ido da wuya, ina ba ku shawarar ku hanzarta kai yaron asibiti mafi kusa yanzu-yanzu domin a fara ba shi maganin gaggawa don ceton rayuwarsa.
